Area.evidence_source: The findings revealed that some of the decedents, because of sorrow and feeling of hopelessness, may have resorted to alcohol as a way of getting relief. Unfortunately, that experience could not last long and they were back to misery as these voices below seem to imply: . . . when he lost the case [the land], he was sorrowful, sometimes . . . he . . . could go and drink alcohol, whenever sober, his head used to get down again but once drunk, his head was up, on and off until such a time that he could not stand it anymore and he committed suicide.
